attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter thakre-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 thakre-care-home dhunche-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-school benighat-care-home
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter benighat-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
</plan>
COST: 136

All six people are rescued, with no deferrals. Dhunche school is not a designated evacuation point, so the children are carried out to Tarkeshwar shelter rather than left there. The route through Benighat on the return from Dhunche (52 + 6 minutes) is cheaper than going back through Thakre (30 + 36 minutes).
